[appendix,obligation=normative]
== Protocol Buffers schema

=== General

This annex states the message definitions of the serialized form: 35 messages and 166 fields.

The tag of a field is normative; it identifies the field on the wire and SHALL NOT be reused. A field marked mandatory SHALL be present. A field marked optional MAY be absent, and a <<consumer,consumer>> SHALL accept a message in which it is. A field marked repeated holds zero or more values. A field marked deprecated SHALL NOT be written by a <<producer,producer>>, and a consumer that reads one SHALL ignore it.

The obligations are those in force at the IR version stated in <<ir-version-specified>>.

NOTE: 23 of the 166 fields are mandatory. Protocol Buffers cannot express the distinction: in the syntax this schema uses every field is optional, and the obligation is carried in the comments. Stating it in a table is the reason this annex exists.
